name: realtime-collaborative-workspace
description: Real-time collaborative whiteboard: React + Yjs (CRDT) + Node.js + PostgreSQL + Redis

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
scripts.db:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d db redis
